themes.description: Users report that the app is consistently unresponsive, crashes, freezes, and provides no useful functionality, leading to frustration and abandonment.
themes.business_impact: High churn rate among active users and a steep decline in app store rating, directly reducing revenue from in‑app purchases and ad impressions.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app suffers from poor code quality, insufficient memory management, and aggressive ad integration, causing frequent crashes and sluggish performance.
themes.action_plan:
• Implement crash reporting and log monitoring
• Conduct a root‑cause analysis of crash reports to identify memory leaks or unhandled exceptions
• Refactor ad integration to use lightweight SDKs or offline caching
• Optimize UI rendering and reduce heavy background tasks
• Perform extensive regression and load testing before release
• Monitor post‑release metrics and iterate

themes.description: Users report that Groww’s per‑order brokerage and related charges are unexpectedly high, leading to significant loss of profits, especially for small‑value trades. The company’s marketing promises zero brokerage for active traders, but statements reveal thousands of rupees in brokerage fees per transaction.
themes.business_impact: High transaction costs erode the profit margins of small‑value traders, discouraging frequent intraday activity and potentially driving those users to lower‑fee competitors, impacting revenue from trading commissions.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The fee model still applies a fixed per‑order charge (₹20) regardless of trade size, coupled with undisclosed DP/MIS and other fees, while marketing language fails to clarify these costs, creating a perception of hidden charges.
themes.action_plan:
• 1) Reevaluate per‑order fee structure and consider a tiered model based on trade value or frequency
• 2) Conduct a transparent fee audit and publish detailed fee breakdowns on the app and website
• 3) Update marketing collateral to accurately reflect fee policy and avoid misleading claims
• 4) Introduce a lower‑fee option or free brokerage for micro‑trades to retain small‑value users
• 5) Roll out in‑app notifications explaining fee changes and offer educational resources on cost optimization
